annotations.title: Change one detail of a personal event (hosts only)

description: To change an existing event's pass palette or color ("change the color to sage"): call this tool with `field` "color" or "palette". THE HOSTS' OWN EDIT of a wedding or other personal event. IT APPLIES THE CHANGE ON THIS CALL, one `field` per call, and the reply says the detail now and before: read both out. A time needs am or pm, or a 24 hour time that reads one way; a bare "4:30" is refused. For faq_answer, `question` adds the entry or replaces its answer. Every change is logged and can be read back; event_change_undo reverses the caller's own latest one. Only the hosts can change it; read refusals (NOT_A_HOST, BAD_TIME, NO_SUCH_PLACE, NO_SUCH_ENTRY, NO_CHANGE) out as given; it sends no message and it changes nothing else on the event; the event's Wallet passes are updated with the new detail as a lock-screen notice and the reply's `passNotice` says how many passes were reached. Needs a personal connector token. ANY PART OF AN EVENT: with `section` and `op` (add, edit, remove, reorder) this changes the name, dates, venue, address, cover, FAQ, about text, speakers, booths and session details of a conference as well as a wedding. It applies on this call; a name, dates or time change previews first (confirm with the changeId). Read the reply out: it says what followed on the pass, the page and here, and what did not. Guests are never told unless the reply offers it and they say yes. A session's time, room and title, adding and cancelling one, keep the session tools. event_change_undo reverses their own latest. START TIME: `field` "start_time" sets the time a one day personal event starts, with no schedule needed. `value`: "5 PM" or "5 PM to 9 PM" (am or pm required), or "clear" to remove it. It can also change the event's dates: give the new first and last day, and any agenda items outside the new dates are listed back to you before anything is removed. A time may run past midnight ("10 PM to 2 AM" ends the next morning), and one item can be added on several days at once or span days. LANGUAGE: `field` "language" with `value` a language code (en, es) sets the language guests see on the passes, the add page and notices; issued passes relabel quietly, with no alert, and the hosts' own text is untouched. COVER PHOTO: `field` "cover_photo" (any `value`, e.g. "add") answers with a one-time link to our upload page; give the host the link and its sentence. The photo goes from their phone to us, never through this chat. Call it again after they say done: the reply carries the pass preview with the photo. PALETTE: `field` "palette" with a palette name, or "color" with a color name or #rrggbb, changes the pass colors; the text color is chosen so it stays readable. Without `confirm` the reply is a preview: show it, and only on a yes call again with confirm true. Issued passes update quietly, with no alert. PARTY LINK: `field` "party_link" runs one shareable link for a personal event; anyone who taps it adds their own pass. `value`: on, pause, resume, status (the count and the latest adds), regenerate (the old link stops), revoke all, or settings like "cap 80, names on, one per phone off, expires 2026-11-15". "sign in none" lets anyone with the link add a pass with no phone number and no code (no text updates, the host sees a count only, the cap counts every add, and a shared link admits anyone until regenerate); "sign in phone" asks for the number again. GUEST CODE: `field` "guest_code" changes the code guests type to open a private event's page; `value` is the new code (4 to 32 letters and digits) or "new" for a fresh one. The old code stops working. Read the new code back to the host. SHARE PREVIEW: `field` "share_level" sets what a texted link to a personal event previews as. `value`: branded (cover photo, name, date), name_only (a card with the name and date), private ("A private event", nothing else), or status (what the link looks like now, with the image url). LOOK: `field` "page_template" picks the guest page template (summit, market, gala, garden), "pass_style" the Google pass style (A, C, D, E, F, G), and "title_font" the title face for the event page and the share card only (Bodoni Moda, Sofia Sans Extra Condensed, Fredoka, Jost, Caprasimo, or default for the template's own); the pass always uses the system font. `value` "status" answers the current look. EYEBROW: `field` "eyebrow" sets the short word the guest page prints over the event name instead of its kind (2 to 24 characters, for example "Live music"); `value` "none" goes back to the kind. RSVP, HOSTED BY, GUEST: `field` "rsvp" takes "on" or "off" in `value`; "hosted_by" takes the host name to show (empty clears it); "guest_add" takes the guest name in `value` and their number in `phone`, shows a preview, then call again with confirm: true and the confirmToken. Adding a guest never texts them.

changeId.description: With confirm: the changeId the preview returned.

confirm.description: For guest_add: true to add the guest after the preview.

confirmToken.description: For guest_add: the token the preview returned.

days.description: For schedule_series: the days, each YYYY-MM-DD, or ["every day"].

endDay.description: For schedule_series: the YYYY-MM-DD an item that spans days ends on (one day in days).

entryTitle.description: For schedule_time: the row title as spelled.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or the event name as the hosts spell it.

field.description: Which detail. The place fields take an optional `venueName`; schedule_time takes `entryTitle`; faq_answer takes `question`. start_time takes a time like "5 PM" in value. event_dates takes "YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD" in value; schedule_series takes entryTitle, a time range in value, and days. language takes a code in `value`. cover_photo answers with an upload link. cover_focus: a link to move the focus point of the current cover photo (passes and cards update on their own). palette takes a palette name, color a color name or #rrggbb. party_link takes a phrase in `value`.; name renames the event (2 to 80 characters) and subtitle sets its subtitle (up to 120, empty clears it) guest_code takes the new code or "new" in `value`. share_level takes a level or status in `value`. family re-homes the event (private-social, conference, fair-stroll, tournament); confirm true applies a re-home that waits for the host. page_template, pass_style and title_font take the choice or status in `value`. eyebrow takes the words, or "none", in `value`. rsvp takes "on" or "off"; hosted_by takes a name; guest_add takes the guest name in value and their number in phone.

id.description: Which row, as they say it: a name, a question or an id.

index.description: Which row by position, 1 is first.

section.description: Which part of the event, instead of `field`.

value.description: The new value, as they say it: a time, a place, a sentence, an answer, or for a section that takes several parts a small object. No links or markup.

venueName.description: Optional venue name, for the place fields.
